IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_SEC_LEDGER' and table_schema = 'D360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE D360.STG_EDS_SEC_LEDGER;
END;

CREATE TABLE [D360].[STG_EDS_SEC_LEDGER]
( 
	[H]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[CUSTCODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[LAST6_ACCT_NUM] [varchar](6)  NULL,
	[REFCODE] [varchar](2)  NULL,
	[REFNO] [int]  NULL,
	[REFDATE] [date]  NULL,
	[DUEDATE] [date]  NULL,
	[CURRCODE] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[CURRAMT] [numeric](18,2)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime2](7)  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO


CREATE TABLE [EDS].[SEC_LEDGER]
( 
	AS_OF_DATE DATE NULL,
	[CUSTCODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[LAST6_ACCT_NUM] [varchar](6)  NULL,
	[REFCODE] [varchar](2)  NULL,
	[REFNO] [int]  NULL,
	[REFDATE] [date]  NULL,
	[DUEDATE] [date]  NULL,
	[CURRCODE] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[CURRAMT] [numeric](18,2)  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO
